_about: Fresh fit-judge tickets, written and committed BEFORE any Gemini judge call. Used to check that a judge's result on the 14 held-out tickets holds on unseen ones. 'duplicate' tickets have an existing asset (gold_unit_id); 'control' tickets have none in the corpus.

tasks.ticket: Our NOC wall screens need a big panel showing the current time in Tokyo, London and New York.
Operators want to submit maintenance requests from inside a dashboard and have them written to our ticketing API.
Split our request-rate series into trend plus daily and weekly seasonal parts so we can alert on the residual.
Show each team what its GCP and AWS usage costs per day, as metrics we can put on a dashboard.
Write a function that parses an ISO 8601 week date like 2026-W45-3 into a calendar date.
Add a helper that resizes an uploaded profile photo to 256 by 256 and crops it to a circle.
Write a function that converts Roman numerals to integers and back.
Add server-side validation that a UK postcode is well-formed.
Write a script that sends a birthday greeting email to every employee on their birthday.
Add a function that computes the great-circle distance between two latitude/longitude points.
Write a helper that wraps long lines of text at 80 characters without breaking words.
Add a tiny feature that lets users switch the web app between light and dark themes.
